newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products strengthen in line with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products strengthen in line with futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Wednesday.
Naphtha continued to strengthen but buying interest, though good, remained restricted to picking off small top-up parcels.
Gasoline prices strengthened but high prices stalled trade. ARA refiner buying and an open U.S. arb supported prices.
Gas oil was stronger in line with a giant leap in futures but a steep backwardation dulled physical trade.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil was firm and tight. Barges traded between $113 and $115 fob ARA, and at $116 fob Antwerp.
